cards.name: Application
cards.path: Suite that applies to all applications/Application
cards.summary: Root of the Photoshop scripting object model (the predefined global app in ExtendScript, Photoshop.Application over COM). It opens files, reaches the open documents, holds the foreground / background colours, preferences and dialog mode, and is the entry point to the Action Manager (executeAction / executeActionGet) and to menu commands (runMenuItem) and recorded actions (doAction).
use_for: batch pipeline entry point: open each source photo, run a brand action, save, close
set brand foreground / background colours before fills, strokes and gradients
run Photoshop commands the DOM has no method for, through executeAction or runMenuItem
read document / layer properties the DOM does not expose with executeActionGet
silence modal dialogs for an unattended render with displayDialogs
keep per-pipeline settings between runs with putCustomOptions / getCustomOptions
avoid: keystroke / UI automation to trigger commands: use runMenuItem or executeAction instead
makePhotomerge and makePhotoGallery: the harvest marks both DEPRECATED, and Photomerge needs user interaction
the PRIVATE helpers (saveToolBrushToFile, applyToolBrushFromFile, thumbnailStyleFile, thumbnailText): undocumented internals that can change between releases
pixel work on a specific image: get the Document (app.activeDocument or app.documents) and work there
cards.how: ExtendScript: the predefined global app (one per Photoshop process, never constructed); everything else hangs off it: app.activeDocument, app.documents, app.preferences, app.fonts. COM: the harvested typelib library Photoshop has coclass Application, so Python win32com Dispatch('Photoshop.Application') returns the same object with capitalised member names (ActiveDocument, Open, ExecuteAction). Action Manager calls build IDs with stringIDToTypeID / charIDToTypeID and pass ActionDescriptor / ActionReference objects; runMenuItem fires a menu command by its type ID.

key_members.name: activeDocument
key_members.use: the frontmost Document; assign a Document to bring it to the front

key_members.name: documents
key_members.use: Documents collection of every open document (length, getByName, add)

key_members.name: open
key_members.use: open a File and return its Document; optional as (format) and asSmartObject

key_members.name: displayDialogs
key_members.use: DialogModes.NO / ERROR / ALL: whether commands may show modal dialogs

key_members.name: foregroundColor
key_members.use: SolidColor used by paint, fill and stroke

key_members.name: backgroundColor
key_members.use: SolidColor used by eraser on Background, canvas extension and gradients

key_members.name: preferences
key_members.use: Preferences object (Edit > Preferences), e.g. ruler units for plain numbers

key_members.name: executeAction
key_members.use: play any Action Manager event (filters, commands) with a descriptor and dialog mode

key_members.name: executeActionGet
key_members.use: read a property descriptor for an ActionReference (layer, document, application)

key_members.name: stringIDToTypeID
key_members.use: turn a stringID such as 'fitOnScreen' into the runtime ID the calls need

key_members.name: charIDToTypeID
key_members.use: turn a four-character code from ScriptListener into a runtime ID

key_members.name: typeIDToStringID
key_members.use: decode an ID read back from a descriptor into its stringID

key_members.name: runMenuItem
key_members.use: run a menu command by type ID

key_members.name: doAction
key_members.use: play a recorded action by action name and action set name

key_members.name: batch
key_members.use: File > Automate > Batch: run an action over a list of files with BatchOptions

key_members.name: purge
key_members.use: free undo / history / clipboard caches (PurgeTarget) during long batches

key_members.name: refresh
key_members.use: pause until the screen redraws, so a user can see intermediate state

key_members.name: fonts
key_members.use: TextFonts collection of installed fonts (look up postScriptName before setting text)

key_members.name: version
key_members.use: Photoshop version string, e.g. to gate features by release

key_members.name: putCustomOptions
key_members.use: store an ActionDescriptor under a key in the Photoshop registry (read with getCustomOptions)

gotchas: app.activeDocument throws when no document is open: test app.documents.length first

displayDialogs is application-wide: save the old value, set DialogModes.NO for unattended runs and restore it at the end, or later manual work also runs without dialogs (unverified that it outlives the script)

runMenuItem refuses the numeric menuBarInfo command ids ('<unknown> menu item is not currently available', seen in the ps_menu harvest audit); pass app.stringIDToTypeID('<menuItemType stringID>') such as 'fitOnScreen' instead
build Action Manager IDs with stringIDToTypeID / charIDToTypeID at run time; do not hard-code numbers ScriptListener printed for stringIDs, those runtime IDs are not guaranteed stable across sessions

doAction: action and action set names are case-sensitive and must match the names as they appear in the Actions panel (harvest parameter notes), so the set has to be loaded there before the script runs

over COM the typelib has no runMenuItem, system, doProgress*, put/get/eraseCustomOptions, showColorPicker, refreshFonts, bringToFront, beep, togglePalettes or playbackParameters / playbackDisplayDialogs (full list in extra.com.diff), and Open takes a path string; run those as ExtendScript through the COM-only DoJavaScript method (harvested typelib)
foregroundColor / backgroundColor: build a SolidColor, set it, then assign it to app.foregroundColor; editing app.foregroundColor.rgb in place may not stick (unverified)
refresh() pauses the script until Photoshop redraws, so calling it inside a loop slows a batch badly

the ExtendScript member list comes from omv.xml, the CC 2015.5 dictionary generated in 2016 and not regenerated for 27.4; the Photoshop 2026 COM library is the current listing, so check extra.com before relying on a member the 2016 dictionary lacks (harvest notes)

review.changes: doAction gotcha: 'set must be loaded' now follows from the harvested note instead of being cited as it; COM gotcha: added the other ExtendScript-only members from extra.com.diff (bringToFront, beep, togglePalettes, playback*); added a gotcha that the ExtendScript dictionary is the 2016 CC 2015.5 omv.xml (harvest notes). Members, enums (DialogModes, PurgeTarget), example, runMenuItem/fitOnScreen claim (ps_menu audit) and equivalents checked: correct

cards.name: Document
cards.path: Suite that applies to all applications/Document
cards.summary: One open Photoshop document (image): its pixel size, resolution, colour mode and profile, the layers / channels / paths / history collections and the selection, plus whole-image operations: resize image or canvas, crop, trim, rotate / flip canvas, mode and profile conversion, flatten, duplicate, save, export and close.
use_for: resize a master to a social post or story size with resizeImage, then resizeCanvas / crop to the exact frame
convert RGB artwork to a press CMYK profile with convertProfile before print handoff
trim the transparent margin off a cut-out product PNG
save a flattened web JPEG copy while the layered master stays open and untouched
wrap a multi-step script in a single undo step with suspendHistory
walk layers, layer sets and the selection of an image to build or audit a layout
avoid: pixel or style edits on one layer: work on the ArtLayer (doc.activeLayer, doc.artLayers) instead
changing pixel size by assigning width / height: both are read-only, use resizeImage or resizeCanvas
flatten or mergeVisibleLayers on a master you still need layered: duplicate first and flatten the copy
cards.how: Reached from the Application: app.activeDocument (frontmost), app.documents[i] or app.documents.getByName(name), or the return value of app.open / app.documents.add / duplicate. Over COM it is the Document dispinterface with capitalised names (ActiveDocument.ResizeImage, SaveAs, Close). Whole-image commands live here; layer content lives on Layer / ArtLayer / LayerSet objects from its layers, artLayers and layerSets collections.

key_members.name: activeLayer
key_members.use: the selected layer; assign a layer to select it

key_members.name: layers
key_members.use: all top-level layers and groups, top of stack first

key_members.name: artLayers
key_members.use: top-level pixel / text / adjustment layers (add() creates a new layer)

key_members.name: selection
key_members.use: the Selection object: select, fill, stroke, feather, deselect

key_members.name: width
key_members.use: canvas width as a read-only UnitValue

key_members.name: height
key_members.use: canvas height as a read-only UnitValue

key_members.name: resolution
key_members.use: pixels per inch (read-only; change with resizeImage)

key_members.name: mode
key_members.use: colour mode (DocumentMode), read-only

key_members.name: changeMode
key_members.use: convert mode (ChangeMode: grayscale, RGB, CMYK, Lab, bitmap, indexed colour, multichannel) with optional DocumentConversionOptions

key_members.name: convertProfile
key_members.use: convert to a named ICC profile with rendering intent, black point compensation and dither

key_members.name: resizeImage
key_members.use: resample to a new width / height / resolution with a ResampleMethod

key_members.name: resizeCanvas
key_members.use: add or cut canvas around the image from an AnchorPosition (default MIDDLECENTER), no resampling

key_members.name: crop
key_members.use: crop to bounds, optionally rotating and resizing in the same step

key_members.name: trim
key_members.use: cut away transparent or edge-colour margins (TrimType TRANSPARENT / TOPLEFT / BOTTOMRIGHT) on chosen sides

key_members.name: flatten
key_members.use: merge every layer into a Background layer

key_members.name: duplicate
key_members.use: duplicate(name, mergeLayersOnly) returns a new Document copy

key_members.name: saveAs
key_members.use: save to a File with format options (JPEGSaveOptions, PNGSaveOptions ...) and asCopy

key_members.name: exportDocument
key_members.use: export as Illustrator paths (default) or Save for Web (ExportType)

key_members.name: close
key_members.use: close with SaveOptionsType SAVECHANGES / DONOTSAVECHANGES / PROMPTTOSAVECHANGES

key_members.name: suspendHistory
key_members.use: run a JavaScript string as one history state, so the whole script undoes in one step

gotchas: plain numbers passed to resizeImage / resizeCanvas / crop are read in the current ruler units (Edit > Preferences > Units & Rulers); pass UnitValue(1080, 'px') to be unit-safe
resizeImage with only a resolution and ResampleMethod.NONE changes the ppi tag without touching pixels; any other resample method changes the pixel count
passing only width (height undefined) to resizeImage keeps the aspect ratio (unverified)
mode is read-only: use changeMode, or convertProfile with a CMYK profile name to go to CMYK with a specific press profile

close() with no argument uses the harvested default SaveOptions.PROMPTTOSAVECHANGES, so a modified document raises a save prompt that blocks an unattended run: pass SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES or SAVECHANGES
saveAs(file, options, true) writes a copy and the open document keeps its own name and path; without asCopy the document is retargeted to the new file (unverified)
suspendHistory evaluates its second argument as a string of code, so it only sees globals: call a global function such as 'main()', not a closure
many DOM operations act on the frontmost document: set app.activeDocument = doc before working on a document that is not in front (unverified)
backgroundLayer is only valid for documents that have a Background layer (typelib description); a transparent PNG has none and reading it there throws (unverified)
trim() with no type uses the harvested default TrimType.TOPLEFT (colour of the top-left pixel), although its description says 'transparent area': pass TrimType.TRANSPARENT to trim a cut-out
setting activeLayer to a hidden layer can switch that layer visible (unverified)
trap only works in CMYK mode, histogram only in RGB, CMYK or indexed mode; exportDocument defaults to ExportType.ILLUSTRATORPATHS, pass ExportType.SAVEFORWEB for a web export (harvest notes)

over COM the Document typelib has no SuspendHistory, Guides, PrintSettings or PrintOneCopy, names exportDocument Export and print PrintOut; run the missing parts as ExtendScript through the Application's DoJavaScript (harvested typelib)

review.changes: use_for: dropped the 1080x1350 / 1080x1920 sizes (not in the batch); changeMode: added multichannel (ChangeMode enum); trim / resizeCanvas: named the harvested TrimType values and the MIDDLECENTER anchor default; added a gotcha that trim() defaults to TrimType.TOPLEFT, not TRANSPARENT; close gotcha now cites the harvested PROMPTTOSAVECHANGES default; backgroundLayer gotcha now cites the typelib note; COM gotcha: added printOneCopy missing and print -> PrintOut. Members, enums, example (JPEGSaveOptions.quality 10 inside 0-12) and equivalents checked: correct
